remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. "5" in verso inscription most probably indicates it is the fifth in the series and completed on 23 August. The subject of the work is Stapp Lake, near Ward, Colorado. See cat. nos. 1797, 1801, 1802. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Pink and Green Mountains V
Pink and Green Mountains No. V

description: A smooth, gray hill arches across the composition. Beneath it, one red and one blue stripe echo the slope's form.  Above, a pink mountain peeks out from behind the hill, contrasting with a sliver of blue sky.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
